title: Self-simulation with time and space bounds
statement: For every natural number $k$ and every effective coding system that assigns a $k$-work-tape Boolean machine with a finite state set to each Boolean string $\alpha$, there is a finite-state deterministic Boolean machine $U$ such that, for each $\alpha$, some positive integer $C$ works for every Boolean string $w$. Whenever the machine assigned to $\alpha$ produces output $o$ on $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$ and halts at exactly time $t$, $U$ produces the same output on that input at exactly time $C(t+1)$, using at most $C(s+1)$ work-tape cells if the assigned machine uses exactly $s$ cells by time $t$. Conversely, every output that $U$ produces on $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$ is produced by the machine assigned to $\alpha$ after some finite number of steps.
hypotheses_covered: An effective code system assigns a $k$-work-tape Boolean machine with finitely many states to each Boolean string $\alpha$
For each $\alpha$, a positive integer $C$ is chosen independently of $w$, the output, and the simulated time
The simulated machine computes the specified output on the paired input at exactly time $t$
The simulator's space is at most $C$ times one plus the simulated machine's space at time $t$
Any output computed by the simulator is computed by the assigned machine at some time
replaced:
For every natural number $k$ and effective code system assigning each binary string
$\alpha$ a $k$-work-tape binary machine with finitely many indexed states, there exists
a finite-state deterministic binary machine $U$ such that, for each $\alpha$, some
positive integer $C$ works for every binary input $w$. Whenever the machine assigned to
$\alpha$ halts on $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$ at time $t$ with output $o$, $U$ halts on
that same input with output $o$ at time $C(t+1)$, and by then uses at most $C(s+1)$
work-tape cells if the simulated machine used at most $s$ by time $t$. Conversely, any
output produced by $U$ on $\langle\alpha,w\rangle$ is produced by the machine assigned
to $\alpha$ after some finite number of steps.
